overall_notes: The paper focuses on abstractive text summarization evaluation. Key findings: LLM-generated references improve smaller models; contrastive learning outperforms supervised fine-tuning; LLM evaluation shows alignment issues with human judgment. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization of model names and separation of automatic metrics vs. LLM-judge metrics.
